Byomkesh.description: The main detective and truth-seeker who investigates mysteries with keen observation and intelligence.

Rakhalbabu.description: A police inspector who works closely with Byomkesh, providing official support and sharing case details.

Gangapada Choudhury.description: A cunning factory worker who sets up Ashoke Maiti in a scheme and was initially presented as the injured victim.

Ashoke Maiti.description: A man from Meerat who is mistaken for Gangapada and becomes the target of an attempted murder.

Ramchatur.description: The Hindi-speaking part-time servant in Gangapada's house, who goes missing after the incident.

Ratanlal Kapadia.description: The Marwari owner of the Scrap Iron and Steel Factory Ltd., where Gangapada and Naresh worked.

Naresh Mandal.description: A former chief melter at the factory known for his ill-temper and violent tendencies who seeks revenge against Gangapada.

Prafulla Dey.description: An electrician who applies for the melter job but is not relevant to the main case.

Dhiren.description: Rakhalbabu's assistant, tasked with searching Naresh Mondol's house.

Netaji Hospital.description: A hospital in Calcutta where the injured man is taken for treatment.

Keyatala.description: A neighborhood in Calcutta where Byomkesh's new house is located.

Fraser Road.description: A street in Calcutta near which the crime scene is located.

Calcutta.description: The city (now Kolkata) where the story is set.

Meerat.description: A city in northern India (modern spelling: Meerut), where Ashoke Maiti is from.

Howrah station.description: A major railway station in Calcutta, serving as a gateway to the city.

dharmashala.description: A type of inexpensive lodging or rest house, often for travelers or pilgrims.

South Calcutta.description: The southern part of Calcutta, where Gangapada's house is located.

Kashipur.description: A place referenced as the location of Gangapada's landlord.

Bihar.description: An Indian state, mentioned as Ramchatur's likely home.

Scrap Iron and Steel Factory Ltd..description: The factory near Calcutta where Gangapada and Naresh worked as melters.

Bombay Steel Foundry Ltd..description: A fictional company used as bait in the police's plan to catch Naresh.

Gariahat Market.description: A well-known market area in Calcutta, used as a landmark for the fake job interview.

Nagpur.description: A city in central India, mentioned as the supposed location of Nrisinha Mullick's previous employment.

Anglo-Indian.description: Refers to a person of mixed Indian and British ancestry, describing the beggar in the court case.

babu.description: A respectful term of address for men, often used after a name (e.g., Byomkeshbabu, Rakhalbabu).

melter.description: A skilled worker who operates an electric furnace to melt iron in a foundry.

para.description: A neighborhood or locality, commonly used in Bengali (not present in this chapter, so omitted).

ch-1: Scrap Iron and Steel Factory Ltd.
